reason: The primary abstract/full HTML studies CP-decomposition of convolution kernels to accelerate two vision CNNs, including AlexNet and a character-classification CNN. Its evaluations report CNN accuracy/speed trade-offs, not LLM inference, serving, or LLM-oriented compression; this is a clear scope mismatch.
title: Speeding-up Convolutional Neural Networks Using Fine-tuned CP-Decomposition
